title: Gemma 4 31B via Ollama (default tag)
slug_note: The dense flagship Gemma 4 in one command; fills a 24 GB card.

variation.quant_detail: Ollama's default `gemma4:31b` tag, 4-bit class; the tag page lists 19GB - 20GB and does not name the exact quant
variation.revision_note: Ollama model ID shown by `ollama ps` on the Spark when measured (2026-10-26)

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-26): 49.7 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (Ollama 0.40.10 with its own default context on the 128 GB Spark (262,144 tokens)). Earlier estimate: Estimate from the tag size (19GB - 20GB) plus KV headroom at Ollama's default context. Not measured.

drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; Ollama 0.40.10 with its own default context on the 128 GB Spark (262,144 tokens)

caveats: Ollama's default context is small; raise num_ctx for long documents or coding agents.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-26): `ollama run gemma4:31b` answered after 15.4 s from a cold start (model files read from disk); 49.7 GiB resident. Ollama 0.40.10 on the 128 GB Spark picked a 262,144-token default context by itself, so memory is weights plus that KV. Set num_ctx lower to save memory.
